q: The Ruelle-Perron-Frobenius (transfer) operator L_φ acting on continuous functions by (L_φ f)(x) = Σ_{Ty=x} e^{φ(y)} f(y) has a spectral gap for:
opts: Hölder continuous φ on a topologically mixing SFT (or hyperbolic system)
exp: For Hölder φ on a mixing SFT, L_φ has a simple maximal eigenvalue e^{P(φ)} (topological pressure) with a positive eigenfunction, and the rest of the spectrum lies in a strictly smaller disk. This spectral gap implies exponential decay of correlations for Gibbs measures.
